'''Chief Naval Architect''' was a title held by the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] at [[Sienar Fleet Systems Research, Development and Engineering Center|Research, Development and Engineering Center]] of his company, [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].<ref name="VaderTechPlate" /> The position was also held by [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Wessex]] under the corporation [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], as well as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]]<ref name="ATATSpecPlate" /> and [[Imperial Navy Research, Development and Engineering Center]] divisions.<ref name="ISDSpecPlate" />
